AiEvaluationDefinition.description: Bulk test suite for the Rep Support agent — knowledge questions route to answer_rep_questions/search_knowledge; bug/draft/escalate utterances route to the right sub-agents.
AiEvaluationDefinition.name: Rep_Support_Tests

expectation.expectedValue: REGRESSION (anti-fabrication): internal Knowledge has no article stating India's options eligibility — only a tangential FPSL/securities-lending doc that names India. The agent must NOT infer a yes/no conclusion from that tangential article. After searching (and one conceptual retry), it plainly says no internal article confirms India's options eligibility and advises checking with a team lead, ending with a LOW Confidence line (under 40%).
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: Can customers in India trade options?
